_format: vertices are integers, bit i = coordinate i; each cycle is a list of 2^d vertices (closed up cyclically). Keys dN (N>=5): one decomposition as list of N cycles; cycle k is the image of cycle 0 under the cyclic coordinate shift bit i -> bit i+k mod N. d5_all_shift_invariant_orbit_reps: generating cycles C (apply the 5 shifts to get the decomposition).
